text:
Nke iri nke FIFA World Cup ka e mere na West Germany site na 13 June ruo 7 July 1974, na-achịkọta otu iri na isii n’ụdị dị iche na nke a na-akụ aka ugbu a. Agba mbụ kewara ndị otu ahụ n’ime otu anọ nke nwere otu anọ, ebe ndị abụọ kacha elu n’otu ọ bụla gara n’agba nke abụọ nke nwere otu abụọ ọzọ nke nwere otu anọ. Enweghị ọkara ikpeazụ nke a na-akụ aka: ndị meriri n’otu abụọ nke agba nke abụọ zutere n’ikpeazụ, ebe ndị nwetara ọnọdụ nke abụọ na-agba asọmpi maka ọnọdụ nke atọ. Asọmpi ahụ webatakwa FIFA World Cup Trophy nke dị ugbu a, nke e webatara mgbe Brazil jigidere Jules Rimet Trophy nke gara aga kpamkpam site n’imeri ya na 1970.

Agba mbụ wetara otu n’ime egwuregwu kacha sie ike n’asọmpi ahụ. N’otu egwuregwu agba mbụ na Hamburg, East Germany, nke na-eme mpụta mbụ ya na World Cup, meriri West Germany 1-0 n’ọgbakọ nwere nnukwu esemokwu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị. Ọ bụ naanị oge abụọ Germany ga-ezute onwe ha, mana West Germany gbakere wee gaa n’ihu ma merie asọmpi ahụ n’ikpeazụ. Netherlands, nke Johan Cruyff kpalitere, mere ka ndị na-ekiri ya nwee mmasị site n’ụdị egwuregwu ‘Total Football’ ha na-agba, ebe Poland pụtara dị ka ike na-atụ anya, nke ihe mgbaru nke Grzegorz Lato na-akwalite.

Ikpeazụ ahụ, nke e mere n’ihu ndị na-ekiri 78,200 na Olympiastadion nke Munich na 7 July, malitere n’ụzọ dị egwu. Johan Neeskens gbanwere penalty n’ime nkeji nke abụọ iji tinye Netherlands n’ihu, nke bụ penalty mbụ e nyere na ikpeazụ World Cup. Paul Breitner nyere otu aka site na penalty nke ya n’ime nkeji nke 25, nke bụ penalty nke abụọ n’egwuregwu ahụ ma ọ bụ otu n’aka nke ọ bụla, tupu Gerd Muller kụọ ihe mmeri n’ime nkeji nke 43. West Germany meriri 2-1 iji nweta aha nke abụọ ha, afọ iri abụọ mgbe nke mbụ ha na 1954 gasịrị.

Netherlands mechara dị ka ndị nwetara ọnọdụ nke abụọ, ebe Poland meriri Brazil iji nweta ọnọdụ nke atọ. Grzegorz Lato nke Poland bụ onye kacha nweta ihe mgbaru na asọmpi ahụ site na ihe asaa. Enweghị Golden Ball ọ bụla n’ụzọ gọọmentị na 1974; FIFA nyere onye ọkpụkpọ kacha nta nke Best Young Player nye Wladyslaw Zmuda nke Poland. N’ofe egwuregwu niile, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bịara ruru 1,865,753, na-eme nkezi ihe dị ka 49,099 kwa egwuregwu.
